title: Community Health II (CPH2301): Main Exam, Mon 25th March, 2024
department: Department of Communal Health, Epidemiology and Biostatistics
programme: Certificate in Health Recognition and Information Technology
instructions: ANSWER ALL QUESTION IN SECTION A AND ANY OTHER TWO FROM SECTION

items.text: Give two reasons why community fails to participate in immunization programmes.
Name five factors that affects the general immunity of a person.
Illustrate the factors influencing disease occurrence in Kenya.
Using examples describe the principles of managing communicable diseases.
Outline FIVE possible causes of missed opportunities in immunization.
Enumerate FIVE ways by which Health Education can be used in the promotion of health.
Describe the linkage between the community and the health facility and sustainability.
Explain the classification categories of communicable diseases.
Community Health Volunteers form a basic workforce of community strategy in the provision of level one services. Discuss any five roles they play.
Discuss any three disease frequency measures and give its properties and uses.
Giving an illustration discuss disease determinants.
